text: Stabilisers are added to the finished quark, which is then heat-treated in a plate, tubular or scraped-surface heat exchanger to keep longer.

steps.note: The quark is given its stabilisers in the buffer tank, a holding tank, before it is heated.
The quark is heated to kill all its microbes, so it keeps longer.
